notes:
When two things on a page were broken, Docket only ever told you about one.

If your structured data fails to parse, search engines throw the whole block away — the markup is on the page and it does nothing. Docket has always found that, and it tells you the specific parser error rather than a list of things it might have been, because "invalid JSON" sends people hunting for a trailing comma that is not there.

What it did not do was look past the first broken block on each page. Most pages carry two or three: a breadcrumb trail, a product, an FAQ. Docket found the first failure, recorded it, and moved to the next page. Everything it then said about the site — how many failed, whether they all failed for the same reason, whether there was more than one cause — was built from that one-per-page sample.

The effect was a report that read as more settled than it was. A site with a missing comma in every breadcrumb block would be told "all of them fail the same way", and that sentence was true of what Docket had looked at rather than of the site. Fix the comma, re-test, and the pages are still discarded, because a second block on some of them was broken in a different way and nothing had mentioned it.

Found by auditing a computer manufacturer. Thirteen product pages, every one carrying two blocks of structured data. All thirteen had the same missing comma in the breadcrumb — and three of them also had an empty `"description":` in the product block, which is a different error with a different fix. Docket could see one cause; there were two.

It now reads every block on the page. When there is more than one kind of failure the report says so plainly and adds that fixing only the most common one will not make those pages valid. When there genuinely is one cause everywhere, it still says so, because that is the useful thing to hear and it is now a claim about your site rather than about the first thing Docket looked at.

**The count of pages has not changed and neither has the advice for the common case.** If your site has one problem in one place, this release tells you exactly what it told you before.
